recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. If FHIR-I wants additional identifier or description semantics in the current TestPlan model, handle the follow-up in HL7/fhir-testing-ig and consider the current TestPlan.suite.test.name and TestPlan.suite.test.description elements rather than restoring the obsolete core TestPlan.testCase shape.
issue_request: FHIR-42725 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-I. It requested an identifier and description for TestPlan.testCase; the accepted resolution was to add TestPlan.testCase.key instead of another id element and to add TestPlan.testCase.description.
initial_application: FHIR-I discussed the issue on 2024-04-01 and accepted Richard Ettema's proposed resolution on 2024-04-15. Commit c73f9fd93553d43f5069797c458fc0ebe6c98d6c, merged by HL7/fhir#3070 as af86b789611b3bddb6ca80c2ad12ca85988a61cb, added TestPlan.testCase.key 1..1 id and TestPlan.testCase.description 0..1 markdown to source/testplan/structuredefinition-TestPlan.xml.
additional_context: Later TestPlan decisions changed the artifact. FHIR-46628 added recursive TestPlan.testCase nesting, and FHIR-50901 then made the broader Applied/Persuasive R6 decision that the existing TestPlan was insufficient and should be reworked using the Tooling IG TestCases structure. Commit 80ac210e33dd10b2582e5bbcea1000bf4d4fabb4 reworked TestPlan into a suite/test structure. Commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed TestPlan, TestReport, and TestScript from active core source; current source/fhir.ini has no active TestPlan resource entry and instead points to the FHIR Testing IG.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The current checkout has no source/testplan build input, and restoring TestPlan.testCase.key or TestPlan.testCase.description in core would conflict with the later TestPlan redesign and externalization.
